adjudication.depicted_input: Panel A visibly shows the wild-type and mutated nucleotide sequences and the log-likelihood comparison used to score mutation effect, i.e. the sequence inputs supplied to OmniNA/OmniHelix for this evaluation route.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible. Atlas rules do not require a model box when the route-specific input object is clearly depicted. Here the crop visibly contains the mutated and wild-type nucleotide sequences plus the scoring formulation comparing their model log-likelihoods, which is the immediate input-side representation for both listed actual_model_input routes. This is not merely a post-hoc performance plot; the input sequences themselves are shown in the same panel.
